title: DP17164 Real effects of supplying safe private money
title_zh: 供给安全私人货币的实际效应
title_primary: 供给安全私人货币的实际效应
title_secondary: DP17164 Real effects of supplying safe private money
authors: Chenzi Xu, He Yang
official: 官方在线 2022-05-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Privately issued money usually bears devaluation risk that lowers its liquidity and usefulness as a medium of exchange. We evaluate the real economic consequences of eliminating devaluation risk and increasing the safety of private monies in the historical context of the National Banking Act of 1864 in the United States. The Act introduced a new type of federally-regulated bank that supplied safe currency to the local economy as an alternative to the previously existing varieties of unsecured notes. Towns faced a discontinuous cost in creating these banks, which we leverage as a source of exogenous variation in the change in their monetary transaction costs. We estimate the effects of gaining access to safe private money using a market access approach derived from general equilibrium trade theory, and we find that lowering monetary transaction costs increased production of traded goods overall, increased the production share of trade-cost sensitive goods, and spurred structural transformation with more manufacturing output, manufacturing employment, and urban population. Moreover, the growth in manufacturing output overall appears driven by employment and inputs rather than capital investment. These effects indicate that supplying safer money that lowered overall trade costs had a causal impact on US economic development.
abstract_zh: 私人发行的货币通常面临贬值风险，这降低了其流动性及作为交换媒介的效用。我们以美国1864年《国家银行法》的历史背景为依托，评估消除贬值风险及提升私人货币安全性所带来的实际经济后果。该法案引入了一种新型联邦监管银行，向地方经济提供安全货币，作为先前存在的各类无担保票据的替代选择。城镇在设立此类银行时面临非连续性的成本，我们利用这一点作为其货币交易成本变化的外生变异来源。我们采用源自一般均衡贸易理论的市场准入方法，估计获得安全私人货币的效应，并发现降低货币交易成本总体上增加了可贸易商品的生产，提高了对交易成本敏感商品的生产份额，并促进了结构转型，表现为制造业产出、制造业就业及城市人口的增加。此外，制造业产出的整体增长似乎主要由就业和投入要素驱动，而非资本投资。这些效应表明，提供更安全货币以降低整体贸易成本，对美国经济发展产生了因果性影响。

title: Bank capitalization and credit risk: the conditional role of innovation and institutional quality
title_zh: 银行资本化与信用风险：创新与制度质量的条件作用
title_primary: 银行资本化与信用风险：创新与制度质量的条件作用
title_secondary: Bank capitalization and credit risk: the conditional role of innovation and institutional quality
authors: Dzidzogbé Hechely Lawson
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This article investigates the relationship between bank capitalization and credit risk in the West African Economic and Monetary Union (WAEMU) using a panel of 130 banks over 2018–2022, a period that coincides with the implementation of Basel II and Basel III prudential standards by the Central Bank of West African States (BCEAO). The empirical strategy combines fixed-effects estimations with Driscoll-Kraay standard errors, panel-corrected standard errors, cluster-robust fixed-effects models and instrumental-variable checks. Across specifications, better-capitalized banks tend to record lower loan-loss provisions. The analysis also reveals that the capitalization-risk relationship varies across innovation and institutional environments. Stronger innovation ecosystems reinforce the risk-reducing association between capitalization and credit risk, highlighting complementarity between capital buffers and ex ante screening and monitoring mechanisms. Institutional quality further conditions this nexus, with capitalization being more strongly associated with lower credit risk in environments characterized by stronger governance and regulatory enforcement. Overall, the findings support a context-sensitive prudential approach that combines adequate capitalization with improved institutional quality and innovative credit-risk management tools in WAEMU.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2018至2022年间西非经济货币联盟（WAEMU）130家银行的面板数据，考察了银行资本充足率与信用风险之间的关系，该时期恰逢西非国家中央银行（BCEAO）实施《巴塞尔协议II》和《巴塞尔协议III》审慎监管标准。实证策略结合了固定效应估计与Driscoll-Kraay标准误、面板校正标准误、聚类稳健固定效应模型及工具变量检验。在各种设定下，资本充足率较高的银行往往录得较低的贷款损失准备金。分析还揭示，资本化与风险之间的关系因创新和制度环境的不同而有所差异。更强的创新生态系统强化了资本充足率与信用风险之间的风险降低关联，凸显了资本缓冲与事前筛选及监控机制之间的互补性。制度质量进一步调节了这一关系，在治理和监管执行力度更强的环境中，资本充足率与较低信用风险的关联更为显著。总体而言，研究结果支持一种情境敏感的审慎监管方法，该方法在WAEMU中将充足的资本化与改善的制度质量及创新的信用风险管理工具相结合。

title: The Crisis and Job Guarantees in Urban India
title_zh: 印度城市危机与就业保障
title_primary: 印度城市危机与就业保障
title_secondary: The Crisis and Job Guarantees in Urban India
authors: Swati Dhingra, Stephen Machin, Chirantan Chatterjee, Ying Fan, Debi Prasad Mohapatra 等
official: 官方在线 2020-10-03 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper uses a new field survey of low-wage areas of urban India to show that employment and earnings were decimated by the lockdown resulting from the Covid-19 crisis. It examines workers’ desire for a job guarantee in this setting. Workers who had a job guarantee before the crisis were relatively shielded by not being hit quite so hard in terms of the increased incidence of job loss or working zero hours and earnings losses. A stated choice experiment contained in the survey reveals evidence that low-wage workers are willing to give up around a quarter of their daily wage for a job guarantee. And direct survey questions corroborate this, with informal, young and female workers being most likely to want a job guarantee, and to want it even more due to the current crisis.
abstract_zh: 本文利用对印度城市低工资地区的一项新实地调查，展示了新冠疫情引发的封锁对就业和收入的毁灭性影响。研究考察了在此背景下工人对工作保障的渴望。危机前拥有工作保障的工人相对受到保护，他们在失业率上升、零工时工作或收入损失方面所受冲击较小。调查中包含的一项陈述性选择实验显示，低工资工人愿意放弃约四分之一的日工资以换取工作保障。直接调查问题也证实了这一点，其中非正规工人、年轻工人和女性工人最有可能希望获得工作保障，并且由于当前危机，他们对此的需求更为迫切。

title: Price and prejudice: Housing rents reveal racial animus
title_zh: 价格与偏见：住房租金揭示种族敌意
title_primary: 价格与偏见：住房租金揭示种族敌意
title_secondary: Price and prejudice: Housing rents reveal racial animus
authors: Marius Brülhart, Gian-Paolo Klinke, Andrea Marcucci, Dominic Rohner, Mathias Thoenig
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the evolution of housing rents in the proximity of Swiss asylum seeker hosting centers whose populations differ by ethnic composition. Rental prices within 0.7km of an active center are found on average to be 3.8% lower than in the control group. The price response is significantly more pronounced when centers host a higher share of asylum seekers from sub-Saharan Africa. In contrast, neither religious affiliation nor inferred crime propensity of the center populations are found to affect local rental prices significantly. Our findings are consistent with phenotype-based racial animus as a significant driver of observed market outcomes.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了瑞士寻求庇护者收容中心附近住房租金的演变，这些中心的人口构成因族裔而异。在活跃中心0.7公里范围内的租金价格，平均比对照组低3.8%。当中心接纳的撒哈拉以南非洲寻求庇护者比例较高时，价格反应显著更为明显。相比之下，中心人口的宗教信仰或推断的犯罪倾向均未对当地租金价格产生显著影响。我们的研究结果与基于表型的种族敌意作为观察到的市场结果的重要驱动因素相一致。

title: The Inflation Reduction Act’s regional incentives promoted green investment, but did not create jobs
title_zh: 《通胀削减法案》的区域激励措施促进了绿色投资，但未创造就业

abstract: The US Inflation Reduction Act’s Energy Communities provisions aimed to increase clean-energy investment in areas vulnerable to the energy transition, create jobs, and build political support for decarbonisation. This column combines data on renewable energy investment, job vacancies, and elections with survey evidence on public opinion to argue that the provisions successfully promoted solar investment, but generated little employment and did not shift political attitudes.
abstract_zh: 美国《通胀削减法案》中的“能源社区”条款旨在促进能源转型脆弱地区的清洁能源投资，创造就业机会，并为脱碳构建政治支持。本文结合可再生能源投资、职位空缺和选举数据，以及关于公众舆论的调查证据，论证这些条款成功推动了太阳能投资，但产生的就业效应有限，且未能改变政治态度。

title: Did export promotion help firms weather the crisis?
title_zh: 出口促进是否帮助企业度过了危机？
title_primary: 出口促进是否帮助企业度过了危机？
title_secondary: Did export promotion help firms weather the crisis?
authors: Johannes Van Biesebroeck, Jozef Konings, Christian Volpe Martincus
official: 官方在线 2016-02-07 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In the global recession of 2009, exports declined precipitously in many countries. We illustrate with firm-level data for Belgium and Peru that the decline was very sudden and almost entirely due to lower export sales by existing exporters. After the recession, exports rebounded almost equally quickly and we evaluate whether export promotion programs were an effective tool aiding this recovery. We show that firms taking advantage of this type of support did better during the crisis, controlling flexibly for systematic differences between supported and control firms. The primary mechanism we identify is that supported firms are generally more likely to survive on the export market and, in particular, are more likely to continue exporting to countries hit by the financial crisis. In terms of absolute magnitudes, the mid-point of the range of estimates suggest a 6% to 11%, respectively for Belgium and Peru, higher probability of survival on the export market for supported firms and approximately 20% to 10% higher exports for surviving exporters.
abstract_zh: 在2009年的全球衰退中，许多国家的出口急剧下降。我们利用比利时和秘鲁的企业层面数据说明，这一下降非常突然，且几乎完全归因于现有出口企业的出口销售减少。衰退过后，出口几乎同样迅速地反弹，我们评估了出口促进计划是否成为助力这一复苏的有效工具。我们表明，在灵活控制支持企业与对照企业之间的系统性差异后，利用此类支持的企业在危机期间表现更佳。我们识别出的主要机制是，受支持企业通常更有可能在出口市场上存活，尤其是更有可能继续向受金融危机影响的国家出口。就绝对规模而言，估计范围的中点显示，受支持企业在出口市场上的存活概率分别高出6%至11%（比利时和秘鲁），而存活出口企业的出口额则分别高出约20%至10%。

title: Paying to Match: Decentralized Markets with Information Frictions
title_zh: 付费匹配：信息摩擦下的分散市场
title_primary: 付费匹配：信息摩擦下的分散市场
title_secondary: Paying to Match: Decentralized Markets with Information Frictions
authors: Marina Agranov, Ahrash Dianat, Larry Samuelson, Leeat Yariv
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We experimentally study decentralized one-to-one matching markets with transfers. We vary the information available to participants, complete or incomplete, and the surplus structure, supermodular or submodular. Several insights emerge. First, while markets often culminate in efficient matchings, stability is more elusive, reflecting the difficulty of arranging attendant transfers. Second, incomplete information and submodularity present hurdles to efficiency and especially stability; their combination drastically diminishes stability's likelihood. Third, matchings form ``from the top down'' in complete-information supermodular markets, but exhibit many more and less-obviously ordered offers otherwise. Last, participants' market positions matter far more than their dynamic bargaining styles for outcomes.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究具有转移支付的分散式一对一匹配市场。我们变化参与者可获得的信息，即完全或不完全信息，以及剩余结构，即超模或子模。由此得出若干洞见。

title: Recruiting Talent
title_zh: 招募人才
title_primary: 招募人才
title_secondary: Recruiting Talent
authors: Simon Board, Moritz Meyer-ter-Vehn, Tomasz Sadzik
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study a parsimonious model of a competitive labor market in which firms privately screen workers to identify talent. The equilibrium exhibits dispersion in wages and productivity; when talent is scarce, firms with superior screening skills post higher wages, attract better applicants, and recruit more talented workers. High-wage firms impose a compositional externality on low-wage firms, leading to equilibrium inefficiency: Welfare would be higher if low-skilled firms posted high wages and selected first. We also provide a micro-foundation for firms heterogeneous screening skills. When talented workers are better at screening (e.g. via superior referrals), a dynamic version of the economy converges to a unique steady state in which differences in talent, profits and screening skills persist forever.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个竞争性劳动力市场的简约模型，其中企业私下筛选工人以识别人才。均衡状态表现出工资和生产率的分化；当人才稀缺时，筛选技能更优的企业会提供更高的工资，吸引更优秀的申请者，并招募到更有才华的工人。

title: Boom, Slump, Sudden stops, Recovery, and Policy Options. Portugal and the Euro
title_zh: 繁荣、衰退、骤停、复苏与政策选择：葡萄牙与欧元
title_primary: 繁荣、衰退、骤停、复苏与政策选择：葡萄牙与欧元
title_secondary: Boom, Slump, Sudden stops, Recovery, and Policy Options. Portugal and the Euro
authors: Olivier Blanchard, Pedro Portugal
official: 官方在线 2017-06-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Over the past 20 years, Portugal has gone through a boom, a slump, a sudden stop, and now a timid recovery. Unemployment has decreased, but remains high, and output is still far below potential. Competitiveness has improved, but more is needed to keep the current account in check as the economy recovers. Private and public debt are high, both legacies of the boom, the slump and the sudden stop. Productivity growth remains low. Because of high debt and low growth, the recovery remains fragile. We review the history and the main mechanisms at work. We then review a number of policy options, from fiscal consolidation to fiscal expansion, cleaning up of non-performing loans, labor market reforms, product market reforms, and euro exit. We argue that at this point, the main focus of macroeconomic policy should be twofold. The first is the treatment of non-performing loans, which would allow for an increase in demand in the short run and an increase in supply in the medium run. We argue that, to the extent that such treatment requires recapitalization, it may make sense to finance it through an increased fiscal deficit, even in the face of high public debt. The second is product market reforms, and reforms aimed at increasing micro-exibility in the labor market. Symmetrically, we also argue that at this point, some policies would be undesirable, among them faster fiscal consolidation, measures aimed at decreasing nominal wages and prices, and euro exit.
abstract_zh: 过去二十年，葡萄牙经历了繁荣、衰退、突然停滞，以及如今缓慢的复苏。失业率虽有所下降，但仍处高位，产出远低于潜在水平。竞争力有所提升，但经济复苏过程中仍需更多努力以维持经常账户平衡。私人和公共债务高企，皆为繁荣、衰退及突然停滞时期的遗留问题。生产率增长依然低迷。鉴于高债务与低增长，复苏态势依然脆弱。我们回顾了历史及主要作用机制，随后探讨了一系列政策选项，从财政整顿到财政扩张、不良贷款清理、劳动力市场改革、产品市场改革，乃至退出欧元区。我们认为，当前宏观经济政策应聚焦于两方面。首要任务是处理不良贷款，这既能短期内刺激需求，又能在中期提升供给。我们主张，若此类处理需资本重组，即便公共债务高企，通过增加财政赤字来融资或许合理。其次是产品市场改革，以及旨在增强劳动力市场微观灵活性的改革。相应地，我们也认为，当前某些政策并不可取，包括加速财政整顿、旨在降低名义工资和物价的措施，以及退出欧元区。

title: Multi-Matrix Autoregressive Models with an Application to Multi-Modal Network
title_zh: 多矩阵自回归模型及其在多模态网络中的应用
title_primary: 多矩阵自回归模型及其在多模态网络中的应用
title_secondary: Multi-Matrix Autoregressive Models with an Application to Multi-Modal Network
authors: Shiqi Ye, Tingguo Zheng, Han Xiao, Yongmiao Hong
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Matrix-valued time-series data have become increasingly prevalent across diverse fields, including economics, finance, computer science, engineering, and signal processing. However, mixed matrix-vector structures in real-world data present challenges for existing methods. To fill in this gap, we propose a multi-matrix autoregressive (MMAR) model designed to jointly model matrix time series with varying structures. The key idea is to treat matrices as elements and to model their contemporaneous and intertemporal relationships within a simultaneous equation system. In particular, the matrix-valued autoregressive model and the three-order tensor autoregressive model are special cases of the proposed model. We present three distinct estimation methods for the MMAR model, investigate their statistical properties, and provide numerical simulations to corroborate them. Furthermore, we integrate the MMAR model with connectedness network analysis, proposing a multi-modal connectedness framework to estimate the interconnectedness between the rows and columns of matrices. Finally, we provide an empirical application to concurrently model the macroeconomic matrix time series of China’s 31 provinces and a vector time series comprising the economic policy uncertainty, trade policy uncertainty, and geopolitical risk. The findings of the empirical study provide valuable insights for further research and policymaking in the relevant domains.
abstract_zh: 矩阵值时间序列数据在经济学、金融学、计算机科学、工程学及信号处理等多个领域日益普遍。然而，现实世界数据中混合矩阵-向量结构对现有方法提出了挑战。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一种多矩阵自回归（MMAR）模型，旨在联合建模具有不同结构的矩阵时间序列。其核心思想是将矩阵视为元素，并在联立方程系统中建模其同期及跨期关系。特别地，矩阵值自回归模型和三阶张量自回归模型是所提模型的特例。我们为MMAR模型提出了三种不同的估计方法，研究了它们的统计性质，并通过数值模拟加以验证。此外，我们将MMAR模型与连通性网络分析相结合，提出了一种多模态连通性框架，用于估计矩阵行与列之间的相互关联性。最后，我们提供了一个实证应用，同时建模中国31个省份的宏观经济矩阵时间序列以及包含经济政策不确定性、贸易政策不确定性和地缘政治风险的向量时间序列。实证研究结果为相关领域的进一步研究和政策制定提供了有价值的见解。

title: ESG Value in US firms: sectoral dynamics with a COVID-19 perspective
title_zh: 美国企业ESG价值：基于新冠疫情视角的行业动态分析
title_primary: 美国企业ESG价值：基于新冠疫情视角的行业动态分析
title_secondary: ESG Value in US firms: sectoral dynamics with a COVID-19 perspective
authors: Tanvir Bhuiyan, Ariful Hoque, Dominic Gasbarro
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Investors and policymakers are increasingly relying on Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) metrics to inform capital allocation and regulatory decisions. However, prior research on the link between ESG and financial performance (FP) has yielded mixed results, ranging from positive to neutral and negative associations. These inconsistencies stem from a lack of sector-specific analysis and insufficient treatment of endogeneity. This study addresses these gaps by adopting a sector-based approach and employing the Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) panel regression to control for endogeneity, ensuring more robust and unbiased estimates. Using 15,886 U.S. firm-year observations from 2017 to 2023, the study evaluates market-based (excess return), accounting-based (ROA and ROE), and financial stability indicators (Altman Z-score and Kaplan-Zingales KZ Index). It also compares results across periods that include and exclude the COVID-19 pandemic. The findings reveal that ESG performance has a significant influence on financial outcomes, but the effects vary across sectors and performance measures. ESG is positively associated with financial flexibility (KZ Index) in most sectors, while its impact on ROA and ROE is more inconsistent. Sectors such as Energy, Utilities, and Consumer Staples benefit the most from ESG engagement, whereas Healthcare and Communication Services may face ESG-related trade-offs.
abstract_zh: 投资者和政策制定者日益依赖环境、社会和治理（ESG）指标来指导资本配置和监管决策。然而，先前关于ESG与财务绩效（FP）之间关系的研究得出了不一致的结论，包括正向、中性和负向关联。这些不一致源于缺乏行业特定分析以及对内生性问题的处理不足。本研究通过采用基于行业的方法，并运用广义矩估计（GMM）面板回归来控制内生性，从而弥补上述不足，确保估计结果更加稳健且无偏。基于2017年至2023年间15,886个美国公司-年度观测值，本研究评估了市场导向指标（超额收益）、会计导向指标（ROA和ROE）以及财务稳定性指标（Altman Z值和Kaplan-Zingales KZ指数），并比较了包含与排除COVID-19疫情时期的结果。研究发现，ESG绩效对财务结果具有显著影响，但其效应因行业和绩效衡量指标而异。在大多数行业中，ESG与财务灵活性（KZ指数）呈正相关，而对ROA和ROE的影响则更不一致。能源、公用事业和必需消费品行业从ESG参与中获益最多，而医疗保健和通信服务行业可能面临与ESG相关的权衡。

abstract: We develop novel high-frequency indices that measure climate attention across a wide range of developed and emerging economies. By analyzing the text of over 23 million Tweets published by leading national newspapers, we find that a country experiencing more severe climate news shocks tends to see both an inflow of capital and an appreciation of its currency. In addition, brown stocks experience large and persistent negative returns after a global climate news shock if located in highly exposed countries. A risk-sharing model in which investors price climate news shocks and trade consumption and investment goods in global markets rationalizes these findings.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了覆盖发达与新兴经济体的新型高频气候关注度指数。通过分析2300余万条主流全国性报纸推文文本，研究发现：遭受更严重气候新闻冲击的国家往往出现资本流入与本币升值。此外，若棕色股票所在国气候暴露度较高，全球气候新闻冲击将导致其持续大幅负收益。基于投资者对气候新闻冲击定价、并在全球市场交易消费与投资品的风险分担模型，可合理解释上述发现。

title: Supply Chain Risk, Trade and Economic Fragility
title_zh: 供应链风险、贸易与经济脆弱性
title_primary: 供应链风险、贸易与经济脆弱性
title_secondary: Supply Chain Risk, Trade and Economic Fragility
authors: Juanma Castro-Vincenzi, Adry Gracio, Gaurav Khanna, Nitya Pandalai-Nayar
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how equilibrium patterns of production, trade, and input sourcing in complex supply chains are shaped by aggregate risk. We develop a quantitative multi-country model with multi-sourcing across stages. We show that sourcing shares equal an input’s expected output elasticity — its expected marginal contribution to output across states of the world. Risk has a positional effect on sourcing and welfare, operating through offsetting cross-stage complementarity and within-stage substitutability; which one dominates is a quantitative question. An increase in a country’s own risk always lowers its welfare; risk elsewhere has ambiguous, sometimes positive, effects through relative prices. We also show analytically that risk attenuates comparative advantage, as countries shift sourcing away from their most productive suppliers. Quantifying the model for 50 countries and 3 production stages, we show that supply-chain complexity lowers volatility for the riskiest countries, and rising Chinese-origin risk reallocates production and lowers welfare unevenly across the chain.
abstract_zh: 本文研究复杂供应链中生产、贸易与投入品采购的均衡模式如何受总体风险影响。我们构建了一个包含多阶段多源采购的定量多国模型。研究表明，采购份额等于投入品的预期产出弹性——即该投入品在全球各状态下对产出的预期边际贡献。风险对采购与福利产生结构性影响，其作用机制通过跨阶段互补性与阶段内替代性的相互抵消实现；何种效应占主导地位属于定量问题。一国自身风险上升始终降低其福利水平；而其他地区的风险则通过相对价格渠道产生模糊影响，有时甚至呈现正向效应。我们通过分析证明，风险会削弱比较优势，促使各国将采购从最具效率的供应商转移。基于覆盖50个国家与3个生产阶段的模型量化分析表明：供应链复杂性降低了高风险国家的波动性，而源自中国的风险上升则导致生产沿供应链非均衡重新配置，并造成福利不均衡下降。

abstract: We investigate the impact of institutional quality on shielding emerging economies from the Global Financial Cycle. Our findings indicate that countries with a higher rule of law, characterized by superior contract enforcement and more robust protection of property rights, experience a less severe tightening of domestic financial and macroeconomic conditions when faced with adverse global financial shocks. We explain this outcome through a simplified model that incorporates financial frictions, showing how strong institutions and effective governance alleviate collateral constraints and mitigate the effects of global financial pressures on the domestic economy.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了制度质量在保护新兴经济体免受全球金融周期影响中的作用。研究结果表明，法治水平较高、合同执行更优且产权保护更完善的国家，在面对不利的全球金融冲击时，其国内金融和宏观经济状况的紧缩程度较轻。我们通过一个包含金融摩擦的简化模型解释了这一结果，展示了强有力的制度和有效治理如何缓解抵押品约束，并减轻全球金融压力对国内经济的影响。

title: Is Money Overrated? Misperceived Satisfaction from Income
title_zh: 金钱被高估了吗？收入带来的满足感被误解
title_primary: 金钱被高估了吗？收入带来的满足感被误解
title_secondary: Is Money Overrated? Misperceived Satisfaction from Income
authors: Ricardo Perez-Truglia, Rafael Macedo Rubião
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: People often make important choices in pursuit of higher income, but do they place too much weight on income when deciding what path to take? We propose a simple model of misspecified learning in which individuals overestimate the marginal satisfaction from income—the expected effect of an income increase on overall life satisfaction—and therefore give income too much importance in their decisions. Guided by this model, we designed a pre-registered experiment that elicits beliefs about the marginal satisfaction from income and randomly assigns scientific evidence about it. Respondents substantially overestimate the marginal satisfaction from income both for themselves and for others, but especially for themselves. These biases shrink when respondents are exposed to scientific evidence, and the effects persist one month later. To study whether these beliefs matter for behavior, we measure income-versus-non-income trade-offs using job-choice scenarios tailored to each respondent and a real-world decision the respondent is facing. To elicit the latter, we make a methodological contribution: an AI-led interview method that moves beyond static, predefined survey instruments by combining the flexibility of qualitative interviewing with the discipline of closed-ended survey measurement. We find that biased beliefs are consequential: after learning that income matters less for life satisfaction than they initially thought, respondents place less weight on income in their decisions.
abstract_zh: 人们常常为了追求更高收入而做出重要选择，但他们在决策时是否过度看重收入？我们提出了一个简单的错误学习模型，其中个体高估了收入的边际满意度——即收入增长对整体生活满意度的预期影响——因此在决策中赋予收入过高的权重。在该模型指导下，我们设计了一项预注册实验，通过诱导被试对收入边际满意度的信念，并随机分配关于该问题的科学证据。被试显著高估了自身及他人的收入边际满意度，尤其对自身的高估更为严重。当被试接触科学证据后，这些偏差有所缩小，且效果在持续一个月后依然存在。为探究这些信念是否影响行为，我们通过针对每位被试定制的职业选择场景以及其面临的实际决策，衡量收入与非收入之间的权衡。为获取后者，我们做出了一项方法论贡献：采用人工智能引导的访谈方法，该方法结合了定性访谈的灵活性与封闭式调查测量的规范性，突破了静态、预定义的调查工具。研究发现，偏差信念具有显著影响：当被试了解到收入对生活满意度的影响低于其最初预期后，他们在决策中对收入的重视程度有所降低。

title: Reap more than sow: Experimental evidence of spillover effects from free eyeglass distribution among rural students in China

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using a randomized controlled trial across 31 rural junior high schools in China, this study examines the spillover effects of providing free eyeglasses to myopic students on the visual health of their non-myopic peers. Within one school year, the intervention significantly reduced visual deterioration among non-myopic students by 0.48 lines and lowered new myopia incidence by 10 percentage points (a 24.3% decline), while also improving eye-use behaviors. These spillovers cannot be explained by conventional interaction-based or shared environmental mechanisms typically emphasized in non-infectious health interventions. Instead, they are more consistent with observational social learning: non-myopic students observe peers being diagnosed with myopia and required to wear eyeglasses, which increases their awareness of vision risks, updates their risk perceptions, and shapes their attitudes toward eyeglasses, thereby prompting protective behavioral changes. This mechanism extends positive spillover effects beyond context-specific interventions (e.g., infectious diseases) to a broader range of health interventions, and offers new insights into the prevention of non-infectious conditions such as myopia.
abstract_zh: 本研究基于中国31所农村初中的随机对照试验，考察了为近视学生免费配镜对其非近视同伴视觉健康产生的溢出效应。在一个学年内，该干预显著减缓了非近视学生视力下降0.48行，并将新发近视率降低了10个百分点（降幅达24.3%），同时改善了用眼行为。这些溢出效应无法用非传染性健康干预中通常强调的基于互动或共享环境的机制来解释。相反，它们更符合观察性社会学习：非近视学生观察到同伴被诊断为近视并需佩戴眼镜，这提高了他们对视力风险的认识，更新了风险感知，并塑造了对眼镜的态度，从而促使保护性行为改变。这一机制将积极溢出效应从特定情境干预（如传染病）扩展到更广泛的健康干预领域，并为近视等非传染性疾病的预防提供了新见解。

abstract: Short-term reversal appears to have weakened in international equity markets because standard measures mix firm-specific and industry-wide returns. When evaluated relative to industry peers, the reversal persists. Using data from 64 countries, the conventional strategy delivers negligible returns, whereas an industry-adjusted strategy earns 0.53% per month with a Sharpe ratio of 0.74. The effect reflects the reversal of firm-specific shocks masked by persistent industry components. A regret-based signal captures the same industry-relative variation, adding no incremental return. Reversal did not disappear; it was mismeasured.
abstract_zh: 短期反转效应在国际股票市场中似乎有所减弱，这是因为标准指标混淆了公司特定回报与行业整体回报。当以行业同行作为基准进行评估时，反转效应依然存在。基于64个国家的数据，传统策略带来的回报微乎其微，而经行业调整后的策略每月可获得0.53%的收益，夏普比率为0.74。这一效应反映了被持续性行业成分掩盖的公司特定冲击的反转。基于遗憾的信号捕捉到了相同的行业相对变化，但并未带来额外回报。反转效应并未消失，而是被错误衡量了。

title_zh: 执行公平贷款：来自抵押贷款市场诉讼的证据

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Does fair lending litigation impact mortgage lender decisions? Using a novel dataset of all fair lending legal actions from 1991 to 2023, we find that it does. In the wake of legal settlements for discrimination against Black borrowers, lenders significantly reduced denial rates for Black applicants. The reductions offset pre-litigation racial disparities in denial rates by litigated banks, relative to those banks' competitors. Origination rates for Black applicants also increased post-litigation. We further observe evidence of a spillover effect on the approval decisions of non-litigated banks operating in the same city as a litigated bank. Altogether, the evidence suggests that the enforcement of fair lending laws is an effective tool to reduce racial discrimination in credit markets.
abstract_zh: 公平贷款诉讼是否影响抵押贷款机构的决策？利用1991年至2023年所有公平贷款法律诉讼的新数据集，我们发现确实存在影响。在针对黑人借款人的歧视性法律和解后，贷款机构显著降低了黑人申请人的拒绝率。与诉讼银行的竞争对手相比，这些拒绝率的下降抵消了诉讼银行在诉讼前存在的种族差异。诉讼后，黑人申请人的贷款发放率也有所上升。我们进一步观察到，在同一城市运营的非诉讼银行的审批决策存在溢出效应。总体而言，证据表明，公平贷款法律的执行是减少信贷市场种族歧视的有效工具。

abstract: We design a novel survey to study how education shapes households’ joint beliefs about inflation, unemployment, and monetary policy transmission. College-educated respondents perceive the inflation-unemployment trade-off and hold views similar to professional forecasters, while less educated respondents favor supply-side narratives. When exposed to hypothetical monetary policy interventions, the more educated update expectations and adjust consumption and saving in line with standard models, whereas the less educated display greater rigidity. This education gradient persists after controlling for information sources, financial literacy, and institutional trust, pointing to differences in abstract reasoning. Open-ended responses are consistent with college-educated households holding mental models aligned with standard macroeconomic theory.
abstract_zh: 我们设计了一项新颖的调查，研究教育如何塑造家庭对通胀、失业及货币政策传导的共同信念。受过大学教育的受访者能够感知通胀与失业之间的权衡关系，其观点与专业预测者相似；而教育程度较低的受访者则更倾向于供给侧叙事。在接触假设性的货币政策干预措施时，受教育程度较高的群体会更新预期，并按照标准模型调整消费与储蓄行为，而受教育程度较低的群体则表现出更强的刚性。这种教育梯度在控制信息来源、金融素养和制度信任等因素后依然存在，表明其源于抽象推理能力的差异。开放式回答的结果与以下结论一致：受过大学教育的家庭所持有的心智模型与标准宏观经济理论相吻合。

abstract: We study an assignment market where multiple heterogenous objects are sold to unit demand agents who have general preferences that accommodate income effects and market frictions. The minimum price equilibrium (MPE) is one of the most important equilibrium concepts in such settings. Nevertheless, none of the well-known mechanisms that find the MPE in the quasi-linear settings can identify or even approximate MPEs for general preferences. We establish novel structural properties of MPEs and use them as bases to design a "Serial Vickrey (SV) mechanism." The SV mechanism finds an MPE for general preferences in a finite number of steps and only requires agents to reveal finite-dimensional information regarding their preferences in finitely many times. Besides, the SV mechanism also has nice incentive properties.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个分配市场，其中多种异质物品被出售给具有单位需求的代理，这些代理拥有能够容纳收入效应和市场摩擦的一般偏好。在此类环境中，最低价格均衡（MPE）是最重要的均衡概念之一。然而，在拟线性设定中，所有已知的能够找到MPE的著名机制都无法识别甚至近似一般偏好下的MPE。我们建立了MPE的新结构性属性，并以此为基础设计了一种“序列维克里（SV）机制”。该SV机制能在有限步骤内找到一般偏好下的MPE，并且仅要求代理在有限次数内揭示其偏好的有限维信息。此外，SV机制还具有良好的激励特性。

abstract: We use regulatory data on the foreign claims and liabilities of global banks with U.S. operations to study how multinational lenders respond to large natural disasters abroad. Our difference-in-difference estimates show that, on average, international banks do not increase their lending to countries after destructive disasters that should increase the demand for funds. Consistent with information frictions, our results show that post-disaster lending is higher among banks with foreign affiliate offices and stronger pre-disaster lending relationships in affected countries. Our estimates predict substantial heterogeneity across countries in post-disaster international lending, with poorer countries seeing substantial declines and increases among richer countries.
abstract_zh: 我们利用全球银行在美国运营的外国债权与负债监管数据，研究跨国银行如何应对海外重大自然灾害。我们的双重差分估计显示，平均而言，在破坏性灾害发生后，国际银行并未增加对受灾国的贷款，尽管这些灾害理应提升资金需求。与信息摩擦一致，我们的结果表明，在受灾国设有外国分支机构且灾前贷款关系较强的银行，其灾后贷款水平更高。我们的估计预测，各国在灾后国际贷款方面存在显著异质性，较贫穷国家贷款大幅下降，而较富裕国家则有所增加。

abstract: We investigate optimal monetary and macroprudential policies in an open economy with aggregate demand externalities and an occasionally binding zero lower bound constraint. Our analysis highlights that the optimal policy balances output stabilization and capital flow management. When macroprudential policy is available, monetary policy stabilizes the output gap. By contrast, when macroprudential policy is not available, monetary policy is used prudentially. However, contrary to a widespread view, raising the interest rate is not necessarily the optimal prudential policy. Finally, we show that international spillovers operate through the world real rate, but macroprudential policies provide insulation from the adverse effects of foreign policies.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在存在总需求外部性和零下限约束偶尔生效的开放经济体中，最优货币政策和宏观审慎政策的制定。我们的分析强调，最优政策需要在产出稳定与资本流动管理之间取得平衡。当宏观审慎政策可用时，货币政策用于稳定产出缺口。相反，当宏观审慎政策不可用时，货币政策被审慎地使用。然而，与普遍观点相反，提高利率并非最优的审慎政策。最后，我们表明国际溢出效应通过世界实际利率传导，但宏观审慎政策能够抵御外国政策的不利影响。

title: Early Life Adversity and Multi-Dimensional Health Consequences in India: Quasi-Causal Evidence from the Longitudinal Ageing Study in India
title_zh: 印度早期生活逆境与多维健康后果：来自印度纵向老龄化研究的准因果证据
title_primary: 印度早期生活逆境与多维健康后果：来自印度纵向老龄化研究的准因果证据
title_secondary: Early Life Adversity and Multi-Dimensional Health Consequences in India: Quasi-Causal Evidence from the Longitudinal Ageing Study in India
authors: Tripathi, Pragya, Goli, Srinivas
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper investigates whether early-life adversity (ELA) affects later-life health in India using nationally representative LASI data and quasi-experimental variation from cohort differences and the Bengal Famine. We estimate probit models, KHB mediation, and GSEM across seven outcomes: underweight, food insufficiency, poor self-rated health, low cognition, depression, ADL, and IADL. ELA shows a monotonic dose-response relationship with all seven outcomes. Education mediates most of the ELA effect on cognition and IADL, while life satisfaction dominates for depression. Direct effects persist, indicating biological scarring. The Bengal Famine produced lasting health deficits, except for IADL where mortality selection dominates. Heterogeneity reveals larger cognitive penalties for women, stronger physical/functional penalties in Central/Eastern India, and wealth buffers underweight but not depression or self-rated health. These findings survive extensive robustness checks (IV-PSM, inverse probability weighting, alternative ELA measures, birth cohort analysis, and machine learning). Results imply that early-life interventions, especially universal education, can substantially reduce later-life health inequalities in India.
abstract_zh: 本文利用印度全国代表性LASI数据，以及基于队列差异和孟加拉饥荒的准实验变异，研究早期逆境（ELA）是否影响印度人群的晚年健康。我们针对七项健康指标（体重过轻、食物不足、自评健康差、认知能力低、抑郁、日常生活活动能力障碍及工具性日常生活活动能力障碍）估计了Probit模型、KHB中介效应分析和广义结构方程模型。结果显示，早期逆境与所有七项指标均呈现单调剂量-反应关系。教育在早期逆境对认知能力和工具性日常生活活动能力的影响中起主要中介作用，而生活满意度在抑郁路径中占主导地位。直接效应持续存在，表明存在生物性疤痕效应。除工具性日常生活活动能力受死亡率选择主导外，孟加拉饥荒造成了持久的健康缺陷。异质性分析揭示：女性面临更大的认知惩罚，印度中部和东部地区承受更强的身体/功能性惩罚，财富能缓冲体重过轻风险，但对抑郁和自评健康无保护作用。上述结论通过了广泛稳健性检验（工具变量-倾向得分匹配、逆概率加权、替代早期逆境测量指标、出生队列分析及机器学习）。研究结果表明，早期干预措施（尤其是普及教育）可显著减少印度晚年健康不平等。

title: Shifting the reference point in environmental regulation: from polluter‐pays to beneficiaries‐compensate
title_zh: 环境规制中的参照点转移：从污染者付费到受益者补偿
title_primary: 环境规制中的参照点转移：从污染者付费到受益者补偿
title_secondary: Shifting the reference point in environmental regulation: from polluter‐pays to beneficiaries‐compensate
authors: Jens Gudmundsson, Jens Leth Hougaard, Erik Ansink
official: 官方在线 2026-06-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In many environmental problems, emissions are hard to monitor and abatement costs are privately known. We study how efficient abatement nevertheless can be induced through market‐like arrangements that condition transfers on verifiable abatement rather than on measured emissions. We characterize the transfer schemes that implement efficient abatement in unique dominant strategies and show that a single scheme, the beneficiaries‐compensate transfer scheme, emerges under two distinct characterizations: one based on equilibrium properties and one grounded in classical fairness axioms. Under the beneficiaries‐compensate transfer scheme, each agent compensates others according to the benefits received from their abatement. We illustrate its usefulness in two applications.
abstract_zh: 在许多环境问题中，排放难以监测且减排成本属于私人信息。我们研究如何通过类似市场的安排——即依据可验证的减排量而非实测排放量进行转移支付——仍能实现有效减排。我们刻画了在唯一占优策略下实现有效减排的转移方案，并表明一种单一方案——受益者补偿转移方案——可通过两种不同特征化方式得出：一种基于均衡性质，另一种基于经典公平性公理。在受益者补偿转移方案下，每个参与者根据从他人减排中获得的收益对他人进行补偿。我们通过两个应用案例说明其有效性。

title: Production and endogenous preferences
title_zh: 生产与内生偏好
title_primary: 生产与内生偏好
title_secondary: Production and endogenous preferences
authors: Ilya Dergunov
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper proposes a two-sector production model augmented with the endogenous preference evolution mechanism. The preference evolution reflects the popularity of two sectors among investors and captures the idea that preferences for the two goods move endogenously over time. The interaction of preference evolution and market-clearing mechanism generates endogenous movements in Tobin’s Q, risk premia and wealth shares different to the standard production economy of Eberly and Wang (2011). The model also implies that wealth fluctuates across sectors due to the shifts in preferences and subsequently because of expected returns and Sharpe ratios. In the empirical tests, I calibrate the baseline model to the US data sample over 1975–2019 and verify that model predictions are supported in the data.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一个包含内生偏好演化机制的两部门生产模型。偏好演化反映了投资者对两个部门的偏好程度，并捕捉了两种商品偏好随时间内生变动的思想。偏好演化与市场出清机制的相互作用，产生了托宾Q、风险溢价和财富份额的内生变动，这与Eberly和Wang（2011）的标准生产经济有所不同。模型还表明，由于偏好变化，以及随后预期收益和夏普比率的变动，财富在各部门间发生波动。在实证检验中，我将基准模型校准至1975年至2019年的美国数据样本，并验证了模型预测在数据中得到支持。

title: Occupation ladders over the business cycle
title_zh: 经济周期中的职业阶梯
title_primary: 经济周期中的职业阶梯
title_secondary: Occupation ladders over the business cycle
authors: Ismail Baydur, Toshihiko Mukoyama
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies occupational mobility over the business cycle. We divide occupations into two broad groups, "attractive" and "nonattractive," where we label an occupation attractive if the total net inflow into this occupation through job-to-job transition is positive or its median annual wage is above the median of the population. We measure total net inflows into both occupation groups. We measure these inflows separately for job-to-job (EE) transitions and transitions from unemployment to employment (UE). We find net inflow from nonattractive to attractive occupations through EE transitions slows during recessions. The relative net inflow through UE transitions has a similar cyclicality. This finding suggests a novel cost of recession: during recessions, workers have fewer opportunities to move to a better occupation.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了商业周期中的职业流动性。我们将职业划分为两大类：“吸引力强”与“吸引力弱”，其中，若某职业通过工作间转换实现的总净流入为正，或其年薪中位数高于总体中位数，则将其标记为吸引力强。我们分别衡量了这两类职业群体的总净流入，并针对工作间转换（EE）及从失业到就业（UE）的转换分别测算了这些流入量。研究发现，在经济衰退期间，通过EE转换从吸引力弱职业流向吸引力强职业的净流入减缓。UE转换的相对净流入也呈现出类似的周期性变化。这一发现揭示了衰退的新成本：在经济衰退期间，工人转向更优职业的机会减少。

title: Food inflation pass‐through from agricultural imports in a small open economy
title_zh: 小型开放经济体中农产品进口对食品通胀的传导效应
title_primary: 小型开放经济体中农产品进口对食品通胀的传导效应
title_secondary: Food inflation pass‐through from agricultural imports in a small open economy
authors: Minseong Kang, Seungki Lee
official: 官方在线 2026-03-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper develops a new framework for quantifying cost pass‐through in a small open economy by estimating firm‐level markup responses to agricultural import price shocks. We show theoretically that markup adjustments depend on firms' reliance on imported inputs and demand curvature, generating heterogeneous inflationary effects across firm types. For empirical implementation, we postulate a Leontief production structure that expresses pass‐through elasticity as a function of observed markup behavior and imported crop dependence. Using data on 10,911 South Korean food manufacturers from 2000 to 2021, we document considerable market power and increasing polarization in markups, particularly led by high‐markup firms. Markup elasticities under strategic pricing decisions differ across sectors and firm types, with particularly strong effects for non‐large firms exhibiting low reliance on imported crops. Our firm‐level pass‐through measure reveals stable aggregate patterns over time but uncovers considerable heterogeneity—most notably, rising pass‐through among firms less dependent on foreign crops. These findings illustrate how cost shocks propagate through strategic pricing and underscore the importance of firm heterogeneity in evaluating equilibrium pass‐through.
abstract_zh: 本文开发了一个新框架，用于量化小型开放经济体中的成本传导效应，通过估计企业层面应对农业进口价格冲击的加成率反应。我们从理论上证明，加成调整取决于企业对进口投入品的依赖程度及需求曲率，从而在不同类型企业间产生异质性的通胀效应。在实证实施中，我们假设一个列昂惕夫生产结构，将传导弹性表示为观测到的加成行为与进口作物依赖度的函数。利用2000年至2021年间10，911家韩国食品制造企业的数据，我们记录了显著的市场力量及加成率日益两极化的趋势，尤其以高加成企业为主导。在战略定价决策下，加成弹性因行业和企业类型而异，其中对进口作物依赖度较低的非大型企业影响尤为显著。我们的企业层面传导指标揭示了随时间稳定的总体模式，但同时也发现了显著的异质性——最值得注意的是，对外国作物依赖度较低的企业传导率上升。这些发现阐明了成本冲击如何通过战略定价传播，并强调了企业异质性在评估均衡传导中的重要性。

title: Soil Carbon Sequestration Policy in Australia: The Additionality Dilemma
title_zh: 澳大利亚土壤碳封存政策：额外性困境
title_primary: 澳大利亚土壤碳封存政策：额外性困境
title_secondary: Soil Carbon Sequestration Policy in Australia: The Additionality Dilemma
authors: David J. Pannell
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2025-12-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The Australian Carbon Credit Unit (ACCU) Scheme provides opportunities for farmers to benefit financially from sequestering additional carbon in their soils. The Scheme assesses additionality using a ‘newness’ test; if one of a list of eligible farming practices was not used by a farmer in a 5‐year baseline period, its use within the project is considered to be additional. However, this approach is unable to detect non‐additionality in cases where farmer adoption of the eligible farming practice is increasing in the absence of carbon credits. This analysis uses parameters from the actual scheme, combined with soil carbon sequestration rates informed by scientific research, and calculates net financial benefits to farmers from participation in the soil carbon method of the ACCU Scheme. In most scenarios modelled in this study, the net benefits to farmers from participating in the soil carbon scheme are small relative to other costs and revenues from farming (assuming that a recognised existing design problem with the scheme that is causing over‐crediting is corrected). As a result, the area of additional projects is relatively small and can easily be outweighed by non‐additional projects. Therefore, the expenditure on ACCUs required to achieve a tonne of genuine CO 2 ‐e mitigation can be extremely high: up to 80 times higher than the cost of an ACCU in one of the scenarios explored. The prospects of developing a system that accurately assesses the additionality of soil carbon projects seem remote.
abstract_zh: 澳大利亚碳信用单位（ACCU）计划为农民提供了通过在其土壤中额外封存碳而获得经济收益的机会。该计划采用“新颖性”测试来评估额外性；如果农民在5年基线期内未使用清单中的任一合格农业实践，则在项目中使用该实践被视为额外。然而，这种方法无法在农民在无碳信用激励下采用合格农业实践呈增长趋势的情况下，检测出非额外性。本分析利用实际计划参数，结合科学研究提供的土壤碳封存速率，计算了农民参与ACCU计划土壤碳方法所获得的净经济收益。在本研究模拟的大多数情景中，农民参与土壤碳计划的净收益相对于农业其他成本和收入而言较小（假设该计划中一个公认的导致过度信用发放的现有设计问题得到修正）。因此，额外项目的面积相对较小，且容易被非额外项目所抵消。因此，为实现一吨真实的二氧化碳当量减排所需的ACCU支出可能极高：在所探讨的某一情景中，这一成本可高达一个ACCU价格的80倍。开发一个能准确评估土壤碳项目额外性的系统的前景似乎渺茫。

title: Policy Evaluation for Climate Mitigations in the European Agricultural Sector—A Comparison of Policy Options at Micro and Macro Level
title_zh: 欧洲农业部门气候减缓政策评估——微观与宏观层面政策选项比较
title_primary: 欧洲农业部门气候减缓政策评估——微观与宏观层面政策选项比较
title_secondary: Policy Evaluation for Climate Mitigations in the European Agricultural Sector—A Comparison of Policy Options at Micro and Macro Level
authors: John Helming, Elisa Bardazzi, David Schaefer, Hugo Scherer, Zuzana Smeets Kristkova
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2025-11-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to discuss the micro‐ and macro‐outcomes for the standard neoclassical carbon tax (whose burden falls on the producers) versus the implication of a budget neutral, performance‐based EU Common Agricultural Policy ( CAP ) focusing on non‐ CO 2 emission ( N 2 O and CH 4 , measured in CO 2 eq ) reduction, especially in the livestock sector. The subsidy is budget neutral as financed via the current basic payment of the first pillar of the CAP . The policies are applied to the single farm level model FarmDyn to take into account heterogeneity between farms and regions and the macro model MAGNET to take into account market feedback and possible leakage effects. Farm level mitigation potentials and costs from FarmDyn are used to calibrate the EU27 national milk production Marginal Abatement Costs Curves ( MACCs ) in MAGNET . On the other hand, scenario‐specific changes in prices of agricultural inputs and output from MAGNET are used as input in FarmDyn , improving the consistency of the modelling framework. The results of the simulations conducted in this framework show clear conclusions. On the one hand, imposing a standard carbon tax on non‐ CO 2 emissions in the agricultural sector is the most effective method to achieve a greenhouse gas ( GHG ) emission reduction as the carbon tax can lead to significant reduction of total agricultural GHG emissions ( MAGNET ). Nevertheless, this result is connected to several trade‐offs, such as farm income losses in the short term ( FarmDyn ) and losses in agricultural production and employment (different by country in the EU27 ) in the somewhat longer term ( MAGNET ). On the other hand, subsidising the emission abatement costs allows for mitigating almost completely the negative trade‐offs while still allowing a substantial reduction of agricultural emissions. However, subsidies easily result in overcompensation and increased prices of inputs and technologies that mitigate emissions.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在探讨标准新古典碳税（其负担落在生产者身上）的微观与宏观结果，以及一项预算中性、基于绩效的欧盟共同农业政策（CAP）对非二氧化碳排放（N₂O和CH₄，以CO₂当量计）减少的影响，尤其是在畜牧业部门。该补贴通过现行CAP第一支柱的基本支付来融资，实现预算中性。这些政策分别应用于单一农场层面模型FarmDyn，以考虑农场与地区间的异质性，以及宏观模型MAGNET，以考虑市场反馈和可能的泄漏效应。来自FarmDyn的农场层面减排潜力和成本被用于校准MAGNET中EU27国家牛奶生产的边际减排成本曲线（MACCs）。另一方面，MAGNET中农业投入和产出的情景特定价格变化被用作FarmDyn的输入，从而提高了建模框架的一致性。在此框架下进行的模拟结果得出了明确结论。一方面，对农业部门非二氧化碳排放征收标准碳税是实现温室气体（GHG）减排的最有效方法，因为碳税能显著减少农业总温室气体排放（MAGNET）。然而，这一结果伴随着若干权衡，如短期农场收入损失（FarmDyn）以及稍长期内农业生产和就业的损失（因EU27各国而异）（MAGNET）。另一方面，对减排成本进行补贴几乎可以完全缓解负面权衡，同时仍能实现农业排放的实质性减少。然而，补贴容易导致过度补偿以及减排投入品和技术价格的上涨。

title: The Causal Effect of Parents' Education on Children's Earnings
title_zh: 父母教育对子女收入的因果效应
title_primary: 父母教育对子女收入的因果效应
title_secondary: The Causal Effect of Parents' Education on Children's Earnings
authors: Sang Yoon (Tim) Lee, Nicolas Roys, Ananth Seshadri
official: 官方在线 2025-09-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We present a model of endogenous schooling and earnings to isolate the causal effect of parents' education on children's education and earnings outcomes. The model suggests that parents' education is positively related to children's earnings, but its relationship with children's education is ambiguous. Identification is achieved by comparing the earnings of children with the same length of schooling, whose parents have different lengths of schooling. The model also features heterogeneous preferences for schooling, and is estimated using HRS data. The observed correlation between parents' and children's years of schooling is largely driven by the correlation between parents' schooling and children's unobserved preferences for schooling. This is partly offset by a slightly negative, structural relationship between parents' and children's schooling choices, resulting in an IV coefficient smaller than OLS when exogenously increasing parents' schooling. Nonetheless, an exogenous one-year increase in parents' schooling raises children's lifetime earnings by 2 percent on average.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个内生教育年限与收入模型，以分离父母教育对子女教育及收入结果的因果效应。模型表明，父母教育与子女收入呈正相关，但与子女教育的关系并不明确。通过比较父母教育年限不同但子女受教育年限相同的个体收入，实现了因果识别。该模型还纳入了对教育偏好的异质性，并利用HRS数据进行估计。观察到的父母与子女教育年限的相关性，主要源于父母教育与子女未观测到的教育偏好之间的相关性。这一效应部分被父母与子女教育选择之间微弱的负向结构性关系所抵消，导致当外生提高父母教育年限时，工具变量估计系数小于普通最小二乘法。尽管如此，父母教育年限外生增加一年，仍能使子女终身收入平均提高2%。

title: Working Hours, Top Management Appointments, and Gender: Evidence from Linked Employer-Employee Data
title_zh: 工作时间、高管任命与性别：基于雇主-雇员匹配数据的证据
title_primary: 工作时间、高管任命与性别：基于雇主-雇员匹配数据的证据
title_secondary: Working Hours, Top Management Appointments, and Gender: Evidence from Linked Employer-Employee Data
authors: Anders Frederiksen, Takao Kato, Nina Smith
official: 官方在线 2024-10-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using Danish registry data linked to the Labor Force Survey, we provide the first rigorous evidence with external validity on the hours-career nexus (positive association between hours and career success). Guided by three theories (human capital; rat race; tournament), we unpack the hours-career nexus through examining: the differential effect of hours in the present firm and elsewhere; hours relative to peers’ hours; standard vs. evening/night/weekend hours; and the importance of sustaining long hours. Supplemented by the time use survey, we show the gender gap in hours and career success is due mostly to gendered division of labor in household production.
abstract_zh: 利用丹麦登记数据与劳动力调查的关联，我们首次提供了关于工时与职业发展关联（即工时与职业成功之间的正相关关系）且具有外部效度的严谨证据。基于三种理论（人力资本理论、竞争性工作理论、锦标赛理论），我们通过以下维度解析工时与职业发展的关联：当前企业内工时与其他企业工时的差异化效应；工时相对于同行的相对水平；标准工时与晚间/夜间/周末工时的差异；以及持续超长工时的重要性。结合时间使用调查数据，我们揭示工时与职业成功中的性别差异主要源于家庭生产中的性别分工。
